Jensen C-V8 Workshop Companion

Free technical resource for Jensen C-V8 owners. Covers repair guides, troubleshooting, maintenance schedules, wiring diagrams, alternative parts and the original scanned owners manuals for the Jensen C-V8 Mk I, Mk II and Mk III (1962–1966).

Sections include: Repair & Maintenance guides, Known Issues (rear spring axle plate cracking, overheating, erratic speedometer), Upgrades & Modifications (electronic ignition, power steering), Alternative Parts List, Wiring Diagrams, Selectaride documentation, and the full Jensen C-V8 Registry.
